title: YourMaker
subtitle: High-performance digital marketing and media agency web platform with automated lead acquisition.
summary: A bespoke, high-converting web platform engineered for YourMaker Agency. Features custom typography, interactive service showcases, automated client onboarding drawers, and real-time CRM lead capture.
challenge: YourMaker Agency faced significant bottlenecks with slow manual lead capture and off-hours prospect inquiry delays.

Without a high-converting digital web platform, potential clients seeking agency growth services experienced response friction, resulting in lost discovery opportunities and manual sales qualification overhead.
solution: We engineered a custom AI-Powered Business Website built on Next.js for sub-second page delivery, localized SEO, and maximum conversion performance.
The platform features interactive service pricing calculators, instant client inquiry flows, and automated webhook synchronization connecting website leads directly to their backend CRM database.
results: Increased lead-to-consultation conversion rate by 45% within the first month of deployment.
Accelerated new client onboarding speeds by 3x through automated intake workflows.
Achieved 100% automated synchronization between website contact drawers and agency CRM records.
